title: Supercell射击游戏Boat Game重返限量测试
content:
Supercell shooter Boat Game is back in limited testing – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Supercell appears to have revamped its looter shooter Boat Game and is now testing the title with a limited number of players.
The game was
last seen back in October 2025
, when Supercell ran a second alpha test. It was
first revealed in February 2025
, when selected players were part of a first alpha test.
When it first emerged Boat Game appeared to be more of a Sea of Thieves-like game, but the new edition is described as an extraction shooter on its app store listings.
At the time of writing the game’s store page is live on
iOS
and
Google Play
in the US, Canada, Mexico, Malaysia and the Philippines. We’re checking with Supercell on how exactly the limited test works. The Finnish firm also appears to have seeded the new build of the game with influencers, including
Orange Juice Gaming
.
A reported Discord message from Supercell’s community team reads: “The reception to the game last year was not what we hoped and we’ve spent this year thinking hard about what experience we want to give players and putting those ideas into the game.”
When it was first revealed the game appeared to be more like a looter shooter, but the game’s new store blurb describes the game as “a fast, chaotic extraction shooter where you drop into a strange tropical world, grab what you came for, and try not to get vaporized on the way out.”
